sloka: पुरोधा ऋत्विजः चैव राजा च सह मंत्रिभिः ।आसनेषु यथा न्यायम् उपविष्टान् समन्ततः ॥१-५०-१२॥
transliteration: purodhā ṛtvijaḥ caiva rājā ca saha maṁtribhiḥ ।āsaneṣu yathā nyāyam upaviṣṭān samantataḥ ॥1-50-12॥

translations.english: Thereafter the king looked on all sides and saw all of them seated according to their rank and addressed Viswamitra saying:
